about: WP60: long Word-made reports from holdout-2 (development set since its single exam run). R1a: an OIG highlights sidebar reads beside its column -- a drawn panel's edge is a gutter (panel_gutter), a panel is a sidebar or not as a whole (sidebar_per_box), a footer line below the panels ends the band and, when the footer part already prints it, is that footer (foot_not_band), and the column beside a panel starts at its own text. R2 (a chart's frame is the chart's) is implemented and ships OFF. R1b and R1c were traced and not implemented. All readings are the standard profile's (WP60_RULES, keyed on tab_layouts); the Google Docs profile is byte-identical.

rules.sidebar_per_box: ON -- _sidebar_boxes: the gap is measured from the panel to the column beside it
rules.panel_gutter: ON -- _side_splits: beside a drawn panel PANEL_MIN_GUTTER (2pt), not SBS_MIN_GUTTER; the column's cell starts at its own text
rules.foot_not_band: ON -- _sbs_regions + _drop_footer_echoes: a foot line below every sidebar panel ends the band; one the footer part already prints is consumed
rules.figure_frame: OFF (R2) -- _frames_to_figures is implemented and tested. It removes the labels drawn twice on DHS OIG 25-46 p9 and Llama 2 p17, but by construction turns the labels' text into the picture that already paints them, so the page's text reading-order LCS falls (Llama 2 p17 569 -> 469 words), which the acceptance does not allow; its census flipped 40 boxes across 9 documents, some of them prose (UK integrated review p24: 526 words). Decided OFF by the coordinator, 2026-10-13.

traced_not_implemented.R1b: Hypothesis: Word's square wrap continues the column under the sidebar and ends the band (_side_splits). Traced on DHS OIG 25-46 p3: not so -- the column's body was dropped from the band by the same 6pt SBS_MIN_GUTTER beside the panel's fill; panel_gutter mends it.
traced_not_implemented.R1c: Hypothesis: a tint fill holding text lines read as art. Traced on OPM OIG 2025-IAG-022 p2-3: p2's panel is part of ONE grid cluster with the compliance table beside it (and Word's per-line paragraph shading strips); p3's panel is EMPTY and seeds a figure that grows over the column's bullets. Neither matches the narrowed rule; not implemented.
